items.title: Essex Property Trust (ESS) Stock Looks Like A Discount To Fair Value
items.summary: Essex Property Trust has quietly built a solid track record for holders in recent years, which naturally raises a simple question for anyone looking at the ticker today. Is the current share price of about US$279 supported by the cash flows that the real estate investment trust is expected to generate? Over the past 3 years, Essex Property Trust has delivered a 47.1% total return, so a lot of optimism about its future cash streams may already be reflected in the quote. The business focuses...
